plan.subject: LLM agents

queries.query: ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "LLM-based agent" OR "agentic LLM")
queries.rationale: Catches papers that explicitly frame themselves as LLM agents using the most common contemporary terminology.

queries.query: ("autonomous agent" OR "autonomous agents" OR "AI agent" OR "agentic system") AND ("large language model" OR LLM OR "language model")
queries.rationale: Finds relevant work that discusses autonomy or agentic systems without using the exact phrase LLM agent.

queries.query: ("multi-agent" OR "multi-agent system" OR "multi-agent collaboration" OR "society of agents") AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR "language model")
queries.rationale: Targets coordination, role specialization, and collaborative agent designs that matter for practical system architecture.

queries.query: (planning OR "task decomposition" OR "hierarchical planning" OR "subgoal") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR (LLM AND agent))
queries.rationale: Surfaces work on how agents break down and sequence tasks, a core mechanism that changes runtime behavior.

queries.query: (tool use OR "tool-using" OR "function calling" OR "API calling" OR "external tools") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR (LLM AND agent))
queries.rationale: Captures research on agents that act through tools and APIs, one of the most engineering-relevant design dimensions.

queries.query: (memory OR "long-term memory" OR "episodic memory" OR "retrieval memory" OR "agent memory") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR (LLM AND agent))
queries.rationale: Finds papers on persistent context and memory architectures that affect reliability across multi-step tasks.

queries.query: (reflection OR self-reflection OR "self critique" OR critique OR deliberation) AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR (LLM AND agent))
queries.rationale: Targets agent designs that revise, critique, or deliberate over actions, which often translate directly into practical prompting strategies.

queries.query: (reasoning OR "chain of thought" OR "tree of thoughts" OR ReAct OR "reasoning and acting") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR (LLM AND agent))
queries.rationale: Surfaces agent work built around explicit reasoning and action interleaving, including influential prompting-style architectures.

queries.query: (benchmark OR evaluation OR "agent benchmark" OR AgentBench OR SWE-bench OR GAIA) AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR (LLM AND agent))
queries.rationale: Finds papers defining how agent performance is measured, including widely used benchmarks and evaluation setups.

queries.query: ("web agent" OR "browser agent" OR "GUI agent" OR "computer use" OR "digital agent") AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR "language model")
queries.rationale: Targets agents that operate browsers, software interfaces, or desktop environments, a fast-moving practical application area.

queries.query: (code agent OR "software engineering agent" OR "coding agent" OR "repository-level" OR "automated software engineering") AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR "language model")
queries.rationale: Captures agent research for coding, debugging, and repository tasks that is especially relevant to a software engineer builder.

queries.query: (workflow OR orchestration OR coordinator OR planner-executor OR "agent workflow") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR (LLM AND agent))
queries.rationale: Finds system-level work on agent pipelines, planner-executor splits, and orchestration patterns used in production-style designs.

queries.query: (grounding OR hallucination OR reliability OR verification OR guardrails) AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR (LLM AND agent))
queries.rationale: Surfaces research on common agent failure modes and methods for making agent behavior more dependable in practice.

queries.query: ("retrieval-augmented generation" OR RAG OR retrieval OR search) AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR (LLM AND agent))
queries.rationale: Targets work where agents rely on retrieval or search as a core capability rather than static prompting alone.

queries.query: ("agent training" OR finetuning OR "reinforcement learning" OR "trajectory optimization" OR "process supervision") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR (LLM AND agent))
queries.rationale: Finds papers on improving agent behavior through training, optimization, or supervision rather than only inference-time design.

queries.query: (deployment OR production OR latency OR cost OR efficiency) AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR (LLM AND agent))
queries.rationale: Captures engineering-grounded work on serving, efficiency, and real-world constraints that affect whether agent ideas are usable.

plan.coverage_notes: This plan covers the core LLM-agent literature plus distinct practical angles: architectures, multi-agent coordination, planning, tool use, memory, self-improvement, evaluation, coding agents, interactive agents, robustness, training, retrieval, orchestration, and deployment. I biased toward engineering-relevant mechanisms and system patterns rather than pure alignment theory or generic LLM prompting papers, since the reader wants research that changes how agents work in practice. I also avoided standalone product/framework queries because they tend to be low-precision in OpenAlex.
